tools.name: matcap-palette-20261019.json
tools.description: Browse matcaps as round pans, like a makeup palette: Unity Unicorn's 54 drawn matcaps on its page, and every matcap texture in a Unity project in its editor window. Preview one on a sphere and put it on a material's matcap slot, with Undo.
tools.command_template: Copy scripts/unity-editor/matcap-palette-20261019.cs into Assets/UnityUnicorn/Editor/, then open Tools > Unity Unicorn > matcap-palette
requirements: Unity 2022.3 with a matcap shader: Poiyomi (_Matcap, _Matcap2 ...) or lilToon (_MatCapTex, _MatCap2ndTex).
PNGs of the 54 palette matcaps: node scripts/matcap-palette/make-matcaps-20261019.mjs <out-folder>.
limitations: A locked Poiyomi material keeps a switched-off slot off; unlock it in Poiyomi first. The window says so instead of guessing.
The page's 'Load my matcaps' keeps your files in that browser tab only.
